headline: Police charge two Kosovar guards trained for Denmark's prison in Kosovo with beating an inmate
headline_short: Kosovar prison guards charged with assault
deck: A judge released both men, who deny the charge; the prison service will review their training.
standard: Copenhagen Police have charged two prison officers from Kosovo with punching an inmate repeatedly in a cell at Vestre Fængsel, a Copenhagen prison, on Monday. Both deny it. A judge released them on Wednesday, finding no risk that they would flee.
They had trained in Denmark to guard inmates at a prison the government is renting in Gjilan, Kosovo, for foreigners sentenced to deportation. It is now expected to open in late 2027 or early 2028.

Ina Eliasen, director of the prison service, says it will look at whether its training of the officers is good enough. Anders Vistisen of Dansk Folkeparti, a nationalist party that backed the 2021 agreement, called Kosovo 'a complete misfire' as a destination.
short: Two prison officers from Kosovo have been charged with punching an inmate at Vestre Fængsel, a Copenhagen prison, on Monday. Both deny it. They had trained in Denmark to guard inmates at a prison the government is renting in Kosovo.
